skills.name: Scientific Meditation
skills.description: Focusing the mind, good effect on allies.  *Move Speed +130% (10 sec) *Skill Use Rate +35%  (10 sec) *Skill Hit Rate +35% (10 sec)

skills.name: Sulfur Ball
skills.description: Attacks enemies by rubbing the sulfur ball to generate static electricity. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Cancels enemy buffs   *ATK x 4000% Area Damage  *Moves enemies to the back

abilities.name: Group: Dr. STONE
abilities.description: Dr. STONE Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Silence: Intelligence
abilities.description: Has a high chance of making all Intelligence type enemies' Skills unusable and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
